`VPro 2.0` (*VENUS — Vegetation and Environment NexUS — Professional*) replaces legacy Microsoft Access `VPro64` forms and macros with two interoperable tools built on the same local VPro project format (`.db`) and provincial PostgreSQL `BECMaster` service:

1. **VPro Desktop:** Cross-platform desktop application for interactive FS882/SIVI plot-card data entry, multi-plot datasheet editing, Site Unit and hierarchy trees, 3D spatial mapping, and instant BEC reports.
2. **`vpro` R Package:** Programmatic R companion centered on `ws` (`vpro_workspace` for local `.db` projects or `.rds` snapshots) and `pg` (`vpro_pg_conn` for cloud `BECMaster` connections).

## Shared BEC & `BECMaster` Domain Rules

VPro Desktop and the `vpro` R package enforce the exact same ecological and data-integrity rules:

- **Shared Project & Reference Family:** `<Project>.db` (`_Env`, `_Admin`, `_Veg`, `_Humus`, `_Mineral`, `_Other`, `_Audit`, `_Metadata`, plus `*_SU`, `*_Hierarchy` with `~` breakpoints, `*_Lump`, and `*_Profile`) alongside `VPro64.db`, `VLists.db` (`BCPlantTaxonomy v19`, `BECdb v13`, `LMH25 2023`), `VUser.db`, `VMetaData.db`, `VMessageBoard.db`, and `VPics.db`.
- **Literal Text `PlotNumber` (`Text 7`):** Always stored and joined as text preserving leading zeroes (e.g., `"00337"`).
- **VPro Booleans, Cover Bounds & `99%` Lump Cap:** Yes/no flags map cleanly to R `logical` (`TRUE`, `FALSE`, `NA`); species covers span `0` to under `100%` (e.g., `99.9%`) matching VPro's single-precision cover fields; lumped (`*_Lump`) and `TotalA`/`TotalB` sums cap at `99%` without altering raw field data; `vpro_round_ace()` reproduces VPro display rounding (`1.005 -> 1.01`).
- **`LMH25 (2023)` Soil Horizon Depth Sign & Ordering:** Upland organic `L`/`F`/`H` horizons measure upward from `0 cm` (`UpperDepth > LowerDepth`, ordered `DESC`); wetland `Of`/`Om`/`Oh` and mineral horizons measure downward (`UpperDepth < LowerDepth`, ordered `ASC`).
- **Explicit Cover Precedence:** Plot summaries and community matrices default to `cover_precedence = "strata_totals"` (`StrataCover*` / `TotalA` / `TotalB` when positive; fallback capped at `99%`), whereas `vpro_diagnostics()`, `vpro_pairwise()`, and `vpro_outliers()` default to `"sublayer_sum"` to preserve classic VPro Diagnostic parity.

## R 1.0 -> R 2.0 Migration Reference

`vpro` 2.0 streamlines overlapping helpers into a single consistent naming convention:

| Category | Legacy R 1.x Call | R 2.0 Replacement |
|---|---|---|
| **Renamed (8)** | `vpro_standards_sync(pg, ...)` | `vpro_master_standards_sync(pg, ...)` |
| **Renamed** | `vpro_publish_snapshot(pg, ...)` | `vpro_master_publish_snapshot(pg, ...)` |
| **Renamed** | `vpro_list_snapshots(pg, ...)` | `vpro_master_list_snapshots(pg, ...)` |
| **Renamed** | `vpro_write_rds_snapshot(ws, dest_path = ...)` | `vpro_export_rds(ws, path = ...)` |
| **Renamed** | `vpro_read_rds_project(path, su_table = ..., lump_table = ...)` | `vpro_import_rds(path, su = ..., lump = ...)` |
| **Renamed** | `plot_edatope(...)` | `vpro_plot_edatope(...)` |
| **Renamed** | `vpro_rule(table = ...)` | `vpro_profile_rule(table = ...)` *(supports `table = "Lump"`)* |
| **Renamed** | `vpro_diagnostic_classify(...)` | `vpro_classify_diagnostic_codes(...)` |
| **Merged (7)** | `vpro_master_verify_audit(pg, ...)` | `vpro_master_audit(pg, ..., verify_chain = TRUE)` |
| **Merged** | `vpro_check_lmh25(ws)` | `vpro_validate(ws, scope, checks = "lmh25")$lmh25` |
| **Merged** | `vpro_presence_class_numeric(p)` | `vpro_presence_class(p, format = "numeric")` |
| **Merged** | `vpro_sample()` | `vpro_connect("Sample")` |
| **Merged** | `vpro_project_discover(...)` | `vpro_list_projects(...)` |
| **Merged** | `vpro_project_validate(...)` | `vpro_project_inspect(...)` |
| **Merged** | `vpro_write_candidate_su(ws, cl)` | `vpro_write_su(ws, cl, candidate = TRUE)` |
| **Removed** | `vpro_round_minimum()` | `vpro_round_ace()` |

## Quick Runnable Parity Check (`Sample.db`)

```{r}
library(vpro)

ws <- vpro_connect("Sample")
vpro_status(ws)

# Cover precedence parity: strata_totals vs sublayer_sum on Sample plot 108050
veg_strata <- vpro_veg(ws, strata = "total", combine = "sum", cover_precedence = "strata_totals")
veg_subsum <- vpro_veg(ws, strata = "total", combine = "sum", cover_precedence = "sublayer_sum")

c(
  strata_totals = veg_strata$Cover[veg_strata$PlotNumber == "108050" & veg_strata$Species == "ABIE_RK"],
  sublayer_sum = veg_subsum$Cover[veg_subsum$PlotNumber == "108050" & veg_subsum$Species == "ABIE_RK"]
)

# Profile rules differentiate Table = "Lump" vs raw Table = "Veg"
prof_default <- vpro_profile(ws, lump = TRUE)
length(prof_default$plots)

rules_raw_vs_lump <- list(
  vpro_profile_rule(table = "Lump", species = "EPILSPP", layer = "Any", operator = ">", value = 0, operation = "Add")
)
prof_lump <- vpro_profile(ws, rules = rules_raw_vs_lump, lump = TRUE)
length(prof_lump$plots)
```
